notes: Issue #356 posted 176 San Francisco listings; the first batch (merchants/blackbird/2026-09-15.json, published in https://github.com/nolastan/know-this-place/pull/369) covered the 42 that carried a street address. This batch looks up the address for the 134 that didn't, since blackbird.xyz's own site has no listing that covers them (its sitemap names only about fifty curated /spots marketing pages nationwide) — each business's own site or its own controlled listing (OpenTable, its own social page) is the source instead, one citation per entry. Of the 134: 4 name a city other than San Francisco in their own `neighborhood` field (Berkeley x2, Pacifica, Downtown Oakland) and were dropped before any search; 5 more turned out on search to be outside the city too (Mägo and Tarts de Feybesse are both on Oakland's own Piedmont Avenue, and Viridian is on Oakland's own Uptown Broadway — 'Piedmont Avenue' and 'Uptown' in this app's own neighborhood field are Oakland places, not San Francisco ones) or have no fixed address to find (Roast & Toast Cafe appears to be a Berkeley business only, and Sol y Soul Coffee appears to run as a pop-up rather than from a storefront) — all five are left out rather than guessed at. Two more are exact duplicates of entries already published in the first batch under a different neighborhood label (Little Sweet's Japantown and Mission Bay doors are each listed twice in issue #356, once with an address and once without) and needed no new work. That leaves 128 unique businesses; 3 of them (Papa Noodle, Okaeri Japanese Bistro, Timur Indian and Nepalese Cuisine) are already published on their pages from another directory's read, so blackbird only joins their entry's `also_listed_by`. The other 125 were searched and 114 addresses were found (all cited to the merchant's own site or listing); of those, 106 resolve to an active parcel and are published — 60 onto existing pages, 46 onto newly seeded ones. Eight did not resolve and are left `unresolved` for a human, each checked directly against sf-eas-addresses rather than assumed: Magnolia Brewing's 1398 Haight Street and Roxanne Cafe's 570 Powell Street are both attested consistently by several independent sources, and both are simply missing from sf-eas-addresses today — a gap in the city's own registry, not a wrong number. Moongate Lounge's 28 Waverly Place is missing the same way. Matko's 736 Valencia Street is a condominium, which the occupants rule in the root AGENTS.md defers. The Fly Trap's 606 Folsom Street exists in EAS but joins no parcel. Venga Empanadas' second SF door, in the Salesforce Transit Center at 50 Minna Street, isn't in EAS at all — likely because the Center's retail concourse doesn't carry ordinary street addressing, the same way an airport terminal doesn't. Sens and Teranga are both 'listed at' 4 Embarcadero Center, which is not a street sf-eas-addresses recognizes; the four Embarcadero Center towers each answer to a real street address (Clay, Drumm, Battery, Sacramento) but which one is Building 4's is not settled by anything fetched here, so both are left for a human rather than guessed. A pattern worth flagging for whoever refreshes this source next: Blackbird's own `neighborhood` field is frequently wrong or approximate even for addresses confirmed correct — Scarlet Fox, Question Mark Tavern, Toy Soldier, RM 212 and about a dozen others all resolve to a real, well-attested address in a different neighborhood than the app states, so `neighborhood` was never treated as evidence, only the address was.

coverage.remaining: 8 addressed listings didn't resolve and need a human: 1398 Haight St and 570 Powell St and 28 Waverly Pl are missing from sf-eas-addresses despite being well-attested elsewhere; 736 Valencia St is a condominium; 606 Folsom St has no parcel; 50 Minna St (Salesforce Transit Center) isn't in EAS; 4 Embarcadero Ctr (two listings, Sens and Teranga) needs a human to pick which of the four towers' own street addresses is Building 4's. 9 listings are outside San Francisco and were declined (5 Oakland/Berkeley/Pacifica by neighborhood field, 4 more found outside the city on search: Mägo, Tarts de Feybesse and Viridian are Oakland; Roast & Toast Cafe and Sol y Soul Coffee have no confirmed San Francisco address).
